name: China Master Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: China Master Logistics Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated logistics company in China. It operates through Cross-Border Container Logistics; Engineering Logistics; and Resource Transshipment Logistics segments. The company offers freight forwarding services comprising booking agency, freight forwarding, TCR logistics, air parcel, customs clearance, supply chain management, over-seas network, and consultation solutions. It also provides container management, depot service, container leasing, container technical services, LCL logistics, and bonded logistics services; and international shipping agency, emergency rescue and tugging, issuing B/L on behalf of carrier, chartering and booking, and spare parts logistics services. In addition, the company offers coastal transportation services, such as foreign trade feeder services, domestic cargo transportation, coastal empty re-position, break bulk transportation, special cargo shipping solution, and out of gauge (OOG) containers; projects logistics and professional heavy hauling vehicles solutions; bulk logistics solutions and various value-added services; and cold chain logistics solutions. Further, it provides land transportation management platform. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China. China Master Logistics Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Qingdao Zhongchuang United Investment Development Co. Ltd.
